items.title: Specified bosonic scalar and CAR Dirac model adoption
items.design_state: Adopts the actual constructed scalar and Dirac branches and their species assignments; the QFT-MF04 action-to-equation carrier is present, its interface matches, and its current Step 1 record is ready. Its convention suppliers remain draft inputs used conditionally.
items.physical_scope: A selected, noninteracting real scalar and Dirac field model on four-dimensional affine Minkowski spacetime, with a chosen vacuum and bosonic symmetric-Fock and fermionic CAR-Fock representations. The assignments are model assumptions; no interacting continuum theory, empirical result, or general spin-statistics theorem is asserted.
items.statement: Adopts the displayed free scalar and commuting-spinor actions, their conditional Klein-Gordon and Dirac equations, and the actual test-smeared bosonic and CAR Fock constructions as one specified physical model. Species/statistics assignments and the selected vacua are postulates; no empirical outcome or general spin-statistics conclusion is claimed.

items.title: Specified free state and observable interpretation
items.design_state: Defines the selected smeared scalar and even Dirac observables, vacuum states, generator domains and Born reading. The current QFT-MF04 carrier omits the planned charged-number domain extension.
items.physical_scope: State and observable definitions for the selected flat, noninteracting scalar and Dirac free-field models. Fields are test-smeared; local Dirac observables are even CAR combinations. Measurements use only constructed instruments. The planned charged-number domain remains an explicit conditional input.
items.statement: Defines the scalar vacuum vector state, the bounded scalar Weyl observable algebra, the even local Dirac CAR algebra, and the free H/P/N operators with their exact maximal domains. Measurement probabilities are conditional on the separately adopted finite-instrument model postulate. The intended charged-number operator is explicitly conditional because the current mathematical carrier omits that statement.

items.title: CCR/CAR and particle occupations in adopted free models
items.design_state: Complete conditional CCR/CAR and normalized-mode occupation deduction. It does not prove a general spin-statistics theorem.
items.physical_scope: Conditional algebraic consequences of the adopted bosonic scalar symmetric-Fock and Dirac CAR-Fock free models. The result concerns normalizable one-particle wave-packet modes; it is not a general spin-statistics theorem, an interacting-field result, or an empirical claim.
items.statement: For each normalized scalar one-particle wave-packet mode the finite-particle vectors have the bosonic square-root creation/annihilation ladder and occupation n. For each normalized Dirac particle or antiparticle CAR mode, the number operator is a projection and the generated one-mode subspace has occupations 0 and 1. The result is conditional on the adopted field assignments and AC_omega.

title: Specified bosonic scalar and CAR Dirac model adoption — Examples

items.title: Boson occupation ladder and fermion one-mode exclusion
items.design_state: Complete conditional worked model example, including a normalized bosonic Fock vector outside the annihilation domain and a one-mode CAR exclusion calculation.
items.physical_scope: A conditional algebraic example in the selected free scalar bosonic and Dirac CAR Fock models. It includes a bosonic Fock vector outside one annihilation-operator domain and a one-mode fermion occupation calculation; it reports no experimental outcome.
items.statement: Constructs a normalized one-mode bosonic Fock vector outside the maximal annihilation domain and verifies that a normalized Dirac CAR mode admits only its vacuum and one-particle state. This is an exact conditional model calculation and reports no observation.
